Identify the points that lie on the line $y=5-2x.$
question.worked_solution:
The plotted points correspond to the $xy$-pairs $A(0,5), B(2,1)$ and $C(3,0).$ 

To check whether a point lies on the line, we substitute the coordinates of the point into the equation and determine whether the resulting statement is true.

- Substituting the point $A(0,5)$ results in a true statement:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =5-2x \\ (5) & =5-2(0) \\ 5 & =5\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the point $A$ does lie on the line:

- Substituting the point $B(2,1)$ results in a true statement:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =5-2x \\ (1) & =5-2(2) \\ 1 & =1\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the point $B$ does lie on the line:

- Substituting the point $C(3,0)$ results in a false statement:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =5-2x \\ (0) & =5-2(3) \\ 0 & =-1\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, only points $A$ and $B$ lie on the line.
